text:
سکرواری بدلی، رہے سنیچر چھا؛
ڈاک کہے 'سن بھنڈنی، منجی اندر ڈاہ۔'
romanized:
Sukkarvari badli, rahé sanichar chha;
Dak kahé 'Sun Bhandni, manji andar dah.'
literal_en:
If there are clouds on Friday, and it remains cloudy (shady) on Saturday,
Says Dak 'Listen, Bhandni, put your bed inside'
meaning_en: i.e. it is sure to rain.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
